dimensions.assessment: Affects individual consumers and retail sellers of products containing sodium nitrite across the country.
dimensions.evidence: ban the sale of products with a high concentration of sodium nitrite to individuals

dimensions.assessment: Prohibits the sale of certain high-concentration chemical products by classifying them as banned hazardous products.
dimensions.evidence: Any consumer product containing a high concentration of sodium nitrite shall be considered to be a banned hazardous product

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state or imply any specific federal spending or revenue effects.
Applies a Consumer Product Safety Act product ban to a specific chemical substance under defined weight thresholds.
dimensions.evidence: banned hazardous product under section 8 of the Consumer Product Safety Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanent prohibition taking effect 90 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall take effect 90 days after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Economic impact on manufacturers or retailers of affected products.
importance_detail.rationale: Bans consumer products containing high concentrations (10% or more by weight) of sodium nitrite, exempting food, drugs, cosmetics, and commercial uses.
